comment: Advisory performance budget (design §19.2 item 1, docs/performance.md): ci/bench-report.py warns when a result exceeds one and never fails the job. Set on 2026-10-13 from the first two CI runs (GitHub ubuntu-latest, 4 CPUs, loop filesystems) at about 1.5 to 2 times the slower result. Workloads are budgeted in absolute time: the plain-directory baselines varied threefold between runners, so ratios against them are reported but not budgeted.
